summary_en: This study tests adding pelareorep to FOLFIRI and bevacizumab as second-line treatment for metastatic, RAS-mutated, microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer. Pelareorep, FOLFIRI and bevacizumab are given by intravenous infusion, and how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 study that assesses efficacy and safety.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa el efecto de agregar pelareorep a FOLFIRI y bevacizumab como tratamiento de segunda línea para cáncer colorrectal metastásico con mutación RAS y sin inestabilidad de microsatélites. Pelareorep, FOLFIRI y bevacizumab se administran por infusión intravenosa, y la duración o la frecuencia no se indican en el registro. El resultado principal no se indica; es un estudio de fase 2 que evalúa la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Metastatic colon or rectal cancer with measurable disease
Not candidates for curative surgery or curative radiation
Progressed on or intolerant to first-line oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy, or relapsed within 6 months of adjuvant oxaliplatin
Tumor has a RAS mutation and is not MSI-H or dMMR
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 0 or 1
not_for: Ongoing side effects of grade 2 or higher from recent cancer treatment
Active autoimmune disease or use of immunosuppressive medicines
Another primary cancer in the last 3 years, with stated exceptions
